main.description: A code repository a builder links to their profile, owned by the builder's atproto repo. Tangled repos are owned by the same DID as the builder, so ownership is self-evident; other hosts (e.g. GitHub) are self-asserted until verified. Build Guild's D1 only indexes these.

skills.description: Canonical skill names this repo evidences (builder-asserted; later corroborated from contribution history).
